caption: The drawing depicts a terracotta pot with a wide, slightly flared rim and two small, angular handles located on opposite sides near the top. The main body of the pot is cylindrical and narrows slightly toward the base. The color is a natural, earthy tan with darker brown and black areas indicating age, wear, and cracks throughout the surface. The pot has visible horizontal grooves near the rim and appears to have chips and lines showing its aged condition. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, inset sketch of the same pot viewed from above, focusing on its cross-sectional shape. The background is plain and white, bordered by two rectangular lines, with the artist’s name, Annie B. Johnston, written in the lower right corner.
title: Pottery Flower Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
